description: Implementation of the SmallVector class, including static assertions for memory alignment, capacity management functions, and template instantiations for different size types. Contains modifications from LLVM's SmallVector, adapted for ATen/LibTorch.

classes.name: SmallVector
classes.description: A small-size optimized vector implementation, with static assertions for alignment and capacity management.

methods.name: report_size_overflow
methods.description: Reports when the requested size exceeds the maximum size type, throwing std::length_error.

methods.name: report_at_maximum_capacity
methods.description: Reports when the vector is at maximum capacity, throwing std::length_error.

methods.name: getNewCapacity
methods.description: Calculates the new capacity for the vector, doubling the old capacity with overflow checks.

methods.name: mallocForGrow
methods.description: Allocates memory for growing the vector, based on minimum size and element size.

methods.name: grow_pod
methods.description: Grows the vector's storage, copying existing elements if necessary.
